title: ClientError::Serialize doc says 'request' but is only reachable via WebSocket send path
description: ClientError::Serialize says 'A request could not be serialized to JSON. Indicates a caller bug — the data structure contains non-serializable values.' The only caller is WsSession::send_request. The HTTP call() path uses reqwest's .json() which wraps serialization errors as ClientError::Http. A caller inspecting ClientError::Serialize will not understand from the current doc that this can only come from the WebSocket path, which affects how they triage it. Fix: add 'This error is returned only by WsSession::send_request.' to the variant doc.
